Project planning

Planning a renovation? Start with these three things.

Talk about your project

01

Define what needs to change

Think about how you use your home now and what is missing. A few photographs and a short wish list make a useful starting point.

(Questions)

Straight answers before you call

Not sure where to start with your plans?

Discuss your project

Can we stay at home during the work?

That depends on the areas affected, safe access and the services available during construction. Discuss living arrangements as part of planning the work.

Can we stay at home during the work?

That depends on the areas affected, safe access and the services available during construction. Discuss living arrangements as part of planning the work.

How are changes handled during a build?

Any change should be discussed, priced and recorded before the additional work is agreed. Ask how changes will affect both the budget and programme.

How are changes handled during a build?

Any change should be discussed, priced and recorded before the additional work is agreed. Ask how changes will affect both the budget and programme.

What should I prepare for our first conversation?

Bring any drawings, photographs and a short list of what you want to change. It helps to know your priorities and any timing or budget considerations.

What should I prepare for our first conversation?

Bring any drawings, photographs and a short list of what you want to change. It helps to know your priorities and any timing or budget considerations.

Can you help with a renovation or an extension?

Tell us about your home and the work you are considering. We can discuss the scope and what information is needed to take the next step.

Can you help with a renovation or an extension?

Tell us about your home and the work you are considering. We can discuss the scope and what information is needed to take the next step.

How much will my project cost?

Compare renovation materials and finishes for appearance, care, durability, and suitability for the home. Confirm selections as part of the project scope.

How much will my project cost?

Compare renovation materials and finishes for appearance, care, durability, and suitability for the home. Confirm selections as part of the project scope.

How long will the work take?

The programme depends on scope, approvals, material lead times and site conditions. Discuss a project-specific schedule before work begins.
